cnTitle: 试用期被延长怎么看？看约定、留记录，依法主张
enTitle: How to Read a Probation Extension: Terms, Records and Rights
enDesc: If your probation is extended, check the written probation length and the reason; the law caps probation and it cannot be extended at will. Keep attendance, performance and communication records, talk first, and then assert your rights through labor authorities.
cnDesc: 试用期被延长，先看当初书面约定的试用期长度和延长理由，法律对试用期有上限、不能随意延长；留好考勤、绩效和沟通记录，先沟通再依法向劳动部门主张。

cnTitle: 同事抢功劳怎么看？留痕、对齐、让贡献可见
enTitle: How to Handle a Coworker Taking Credit: Records and Visibility
enDesc: When credit is taken, keep process records and deliverables along the way and align upward at key points so your contribution is visible. Avoid a public showdown; clarify with facts and data, and learn to sign your work and share progress.
cnDesc: 功劳被抢，重在平时就留好过程记录和交付物，关键节点主动向上对齐、让贡献可见；事后不必当场撕破脸，用事实和数据澄清，同时学会署名、同步进度。

cnTitle: 跨行业转行怎么看？先盘可迁移能力，再小步试水
enTitle: How to Read a Cross-Industry Change: Transferable Skills and Small Steps
enDesc: Before changing industries, list transferable skills such as communication, project work, data and management, understand the real entry barriers of the target field, and test it through side projects or certificates while keeping a cushion before any full-time jump.
cnDesc: 转行前先盘点能跨行业迁移的能力（沟通、项目、数据、管理等），看清目标行业的门槛和真实门槛岗，用副业、项目、证书小步试水，留好应急钱再决定是否全职跳。

cnTitle: 被调岗怎么看？看合理性、合同约定与你的方向
enTitle: How to Read a Job Transfer: Reasonableness, Contract and Direction
enDesc: For a transfer, see whether it is reasonable or punitive, how pay and location change, and what the contract says about the role. A mutually agreed transfer is acceptable; a one-sided move meant to push you out calls for evidence and lawful negotiation, not signing harmful papers.
cnDesc: 调岗要看是否合理、是否带惩罚性、薪酬和地点怎么变，以及合同对岗位的约定；协商一致的调岗可接受，单方变相逼退则要留证据、依法沟通，不轻易签不利文件。

cnTitle: 升职还是跳槽怎么选？比平台、空间、风险，不只看薪
enTitle: Promotion vs Job Hopping: Compare Platform, Growth and Risk
enDesc: Choosing between promotion and job hopping is not only about salary. Compare growth space, platform stability, team and manager, and the advancement path on both sides. Weigh the raise and adaptation risk of a move against the likelihood of the internal promise, and consider the career signals in the decade and year.
cnDesc: 留下升职还是跳槽，不只比眼前薪资，要看两边的成长空间、平台稳定性、团队与直属、以及晋升路径；把跳槽的涨薪和适应风险、留下的兑现可能都算清，再结合大限流年的事业信号做决定。

cnTitle: 创业还是打工怎么看？看风险承受、资源与现金流
enTitle: Business or Employment: Risk Tolerance, Resources and Cash Flow
enDesc: Starting a business is not just whether the chart shows wealth; assess your risk tolerance, startup resources, customers and cash reserves, and family buffer. Those suited to steady income can test a small side venture first and only go full time once the model is proven, rather than betting everything.
cnDesc: 创业不是只看盘上有没有财，更要看你的风险承受力、启动资源、客户与现金流储备，以及家庭缓冲；盘上适合稳定收入的人，可先以副业小本试水，验证模式后再全职，不孤注一掷。

cnTitle: 领导偏心怎么看？分清是偏好还是评价，靠实绩说话
enTitle: How to Read a Boss Who Plays Favorites: Preference vs Evaluation
enDesc: If the boss seems to favor others, separate a difference in communication style from an unfair evaluation system. Focus on measurable results and delivery, report actively and seek opportunities; only if you are systematically suppressed should you gather evidence and consider an internal transfer or an outside move.
cnDesc: 觉得领导偏心，先分清是沟通风格差异还是评价机制不公；把注意力放回可量化的实绩和交付，主动汇报、争取机会，若确实被系统性压制，再留证据、考虑内部调整或外部机会。

cnTitle: 工作没成就感怎么看？分清是内容、回报还是成长问题
enTitle: How to Read Feeling No Achievement at Work: Content, Reward or Growth
enDesc: When work feels meaningless, first identify whether the content does not fit, the effort is unrecognized, or growth is missing. Address each case: adjust responsibilities, seek projects that build skills, and close ability gaps; if the platform cannot offer growth or reward over time, plan a move.
cnDesc: 没成就感要先定位是工作内容不匹配、付出不被认可、还是看不到成长；对症调整：调整职责边界、争取能积累的项目、补齐能力，若平台长期给不了成长与回报，再规划跳槽。

cnTitle: 遇不到正缘怎么看？看桃花类型、社交圈与相处能力
enTitle: Why You Have Not Met the Right Person: Romance Type, Social Circle and Skills
enDesc: If romance is scarce or the right person has not appeared, first see the nature of the romance stars (steady versus easy-come-easy-go) and the relationship tendency in the Spouse Palace, then return to reality: a narrow social circle, passive waiting, or a relationship pattern to adjust. The chart gives a tendency, but meeting someone takes action.
cnDesc: 桃花少或遇不到对的人，先看盘里桃花星的性质（正缘型还是易聚易散型）、夫妻宫的相处倾向，同时回到现实：社交圈是否太窄、是否被动等待、是否有需要调整的相处模式；盘给倾向，缘要靠行动。

cnTitle: 暗恋要不要表白？看关系基础、时机与你的承受力
enTitle: Should You Confess a Crush: Foundation, Timing and Readiness
enDesc: Before confessing, assess the relationship foundation and the signals the other person gives, and choose a timing and way that leave both of you a comfortable exit. Be clear whether you can accept either outcome. The chart shows emotional tendency and the current year, but confessing is a real-world choice that should be sincere and not pressuring.
cnDesc: 表白前先评估彼此关系基础和对方回应的线索，选择能给双方台阶的时机与方式；更要想清楚自己能否接受两种结果。盘上可参考情感倾向和当下流年，但表白是现实决定，重点是真诚且不施压。

cnTitle: 异地恋怎么看？看信任、沟通节奏与明确的团聚计划
enTitle: How to Read a Long-Distance Relationship: Trust, Communication and a Reunion Plan
enDesc: Whether a long-distance relationship lasts depends on trust and security, a steady communication rhythm, and a clear, actionable reunion timeline. Make meeting frequency, future plans and how to handle disagreements explicit, then verify them together over time rather than relying on promises alone.
cnDesc: 异地恋能否走下去，关键在信任与安全感、稳定的沟通节奏，以及有没有明确可执行的团聚时间表；把见面频率、未来安排和分歧处理讲清楚，再用一段时间共同验证，而不是只靠承诺。

cnTitle: 前任想复合怎么看？先看当初分开的原因有没有解决
enTitle: Getting Back With an Ex: Whether the Original Cause Was Resolved
enDesc: The key to getting back together is not nostalgia but whether the core cause of the breakup has genuinely changed. Calmly review the original conflict, the evidence of change, and the real conditions of reuniting; if needed, set an observation period to avoid repeating the old pattern.
cnDesc: 复合的关键不是旧情，而是当初导致分开的核心问题是否真正改变；冷静复盘当时的矛盾、对方改变的证据，以及重新在一起的现实条件，必要时设一段观察期，避免重复旧模式。

cnTitle: 相亲多次不成怎么看？看标准、自我呈现与匹配渠道
enTitle: Why Repeated Blind Dates Fail: Standards, Self-Presentation and Channels
enDesc: If repeated blind dates fail, first check whether your hard requirements and soft expectations are clear and realistic, whether photos and introductions show the real you, and whether the channels match your needs. Rank your requirements, show your real life, and keep screening rather than rejecting yourself.
cnDesc: 相亲多次没结果，先看自己的硬性条件和软性期待是否清楚且现实，照片和介绍是否准确呈现真实的你，以及介绍渠道是否匹配；把要求分轻重、把生活面展示出来，再持续筛，而不是自我否定。

cnTitle: 闪婚怎么看？激情之外，先核验关键现实项
enTitle: How to Read a Whirlwind Marriage: Verify Key Realities Beyond Passion
enDesc: A whirlwind marriage calls for calm verification amid passion: values, attitudes toward money, family and in-law relations, sharing of responsibility, and pre-marital debts and credit. Know how each person behaves under pressure and discuss the important matters clearly before binding your lives together.
cnDesc: 闪婚在感情热烈时更要冷静核验：双方价值观、金钱观、家庭与原生关系、责任分担、以及婚前债务与信用；充分了解彼此在压力下的样子，把重要事项谈清楚再决定，避免在不了解时仓促绑定。

cnTitle: 另一半不上进怎么看？分清是阶段低谷还是长期态度
enTitle: How to Read an Unmotivated Partner: Temporary Low vs Long-Term Attitude
enDesc: When a partner seems unmotivated, separate temporary exhaustion or confusion from a long-term avoidance of responsibility and a mismatch in money habits. See whether they will act for shared goals, clarify expectations and division of labor, and give a concrete timeframe for change; if they refuse to take responsibility long term, evaluate the relationship seriously.
cnDesc: 伴侣不上进，先分清是阶段性疲惫、方向迷茫，还是长期回避责任、消费观差异；看对方是否愿意为共同目标行动，把期待和分工谈清楚，给具体改变的期限；若长期不愿承担，再认真评估这段关系。

cnTitle: 被催婚怎么看？守住自己的节奏，也理解长辈焦虑
enTitle: How to Handle Pressure to Marry: Your Pace and Your Elders Anxiety
enDesc: Facing pressure to marry, keep your own pace and standards rather than settling under pressure. Understand the care behind your elders anxiety and respond with a clear plan and progress instead of confrontation or silence. Make clear that you are taking it seriously and what your standards are, keeping the initiative.
cnDesc: 面对催婚，先稳住自己的节奏和择偶标准，不因压力将就；同时理解长辈背后的关心，用明确的规划和进展回应，而不是对抗或沉默；把"我在认真安排、标准是什么"讲清楚，给自己留主动权。

cnTitle: 存不住钱、总破财怎么看？看消费习惯与漏财结构
enTitle: Why You Cannot Save Money: Habits and the Leak Structure
enDesc: If you cannot save, separate unstable income and planned spending from impulsive buying, lending out of guilt, and having no budget. The Wealth and Property palaces show your money tendency and saving habit, but real change comes from a budget, saving first, separate accounts and a cooling-off period to plug the leaks.
cnDesc: 存不住钱，先分清是收入不稳、计划性支出，还是冲动消费、心软借钱、无预算；盘上财帛、田宅可看理财倾向和守财习惯，但真正改变靠建预算、先存后花、分账户、设冷静期，把漏财结构堵上。

cnTitle: 适不适合炒股买基金？看风险承受力和持有纪律
enTitle: How to Tell Whether You Suit Stocks and Funds: Risk Tolerance and Discipline
enDesc: Whether stocks or funds suit you depends not on a wealth star but on risk tolerance, the share of spare money, holding discipline and whether you can bear volatility. Use only spare money, know how much you can lose, avoid chasing rallies and panic selling, and avoid leverage; when unsure, prefer broad index dollar-cost averaging or licensed advice. This is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 是否适合股票基金，不看盘上有没有财星，而看你的风险承受力、闲钱比例、持有纪律和是否能承受波动；只用闲钱、明确能亏多少、避免追涨杀跌和加杠杆，拿不准就以定投宽基、咨询持牌机构为先。本文不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 朋友借钱该不该借？看用途、还款能力与你的承受度
enTitle: Whether to Lend to a Friend: Purpose, Ability to Repay and What You Can Afford
enDesc: Before lending to a friend, see whether the purpose is sound, whether they can repay, and their credit history, and ask whether you could afford not to be repaid. For large sums, prefer a written IOU with repayment terms and, where needed, a lawyer and a written contract. Help genuine emergencies, not endless dependency; if it exceeds what you can afford, decline gently.
cnDesc: 借钱给朋友，先看用途是否正当、对方还款能力和历史信用，再想这笔钱即使不还你能否承受；大额最好有书面借条、约定还款，必要时以专业律师和书面合同为准。救急不救穷，超出承受能力就温和拒绝。

cnTitle: 负债、信用卡周转困难怎么办？先停止以贷养贷
enTitle: How to Handle Debt and Credit-Card Trouble: Stop Borrowing to Repay
enDesc: When debt and credit-card cash flow become difficult, first stop borrowing to repay and stop new large spending. List every debt with its rate, amount and due date, and handle high-interest debt first or negotiate installments. Proactively negotiate extensions or plans with the bank or platform, keep records, and when needed use formal financial-dispute and legal-aid channels.
cnDesc: 负债周转困难，第一步是停止以贷养贷和新增大额消费，列出全部债务的利率、金额、到期日，按高息优先或协商分期处理；主动与银行/平台协商延期、分期，保留沟通记录，必要时通过正规金融纠纷和法律援助渠道解决。

cnTitle: 副业赚外快怎么看？结合本职稳定性与可变现能力
enTitle: How to Read a Side Income: Job Stability and Monetizable Skills
enDesc: For a side income, first see whether your main job is stable, what skills or resources can be monetized, and whether your time allows it. Favor directions that build skills and do not conflict with your main job, test with small orders, respect compliance and contract limits, and avoid large franchise fees or promises of easy passive income.
cnDesc: 做副业先看本职工作是否稳定、有无可变现的技能或资源，以及时间精力是否允许；优先选能积累能力、与主业不冲突的方向，先小规模接单验证，注意合规和劳动合同限制，别交高额加盟费或轻信"躺赚"。

cnTitle: 适不适合买保险？先看风险缺口，再看产品适不适合
enTitle: How to Decide on Insurance: Risk Gaps First, Then the Product
enDesc: For insurance, first assess risk gaps (family responsibilities, income interruption, medical costs), usually starting with protection types such as accident, medical, critical illness and term life before considering investment-linked products. Check exclusions, waiting periods, health disclosure and whether the cover is adequate, relying on the policy terms and a licensed advisor; do not buy blindly or duplicate cover.
cnDesc: 买保险先盘点风险缺口（家庭责任、收入中断、医疗支出），通常先配意外、医疗、重疾和定期寿险等保障型，再考虑理财型；看免责、等待期、健康告知和保额是否够，以保险条款和持牌顾问为准，不盲买、不重复投保。

cnTitle: 年终奖怎么规划？先补安全垫，再谈还债和增值
enTitle: How to Plan a Year-End Bonus: Safety Net, Debt, Then Growth
enDesc: With a year-end bonus, first build the emergency fund (typically several months of expenses), then repay high-interest debt, and only then arrange needed spending and steady growth. Allocate by percentages to avoid spending it all at once; invest only spare money and within your means. This is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 年终奖到手先补应急金（通常覆盖数月开支），再还高息负债，之后才安排必要消费和稳健增值；按比例分配避免一次性花光，想投资只用其中闲钱、量力而行，本文不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 被熟人拉去投资怎么看？先核实，再看风险，警惕人情单
enTitle: How to Read Being Pushed Into an Investment: Verify, Assess Risk, Beware Relationship Selling
enDesc: When someone you know pushes a project, franchise or investment, the more it rests on a personal bond, the more you should verify qualifications, the contract and where the money goes, and understand risk, the source of returns and the exit mechanism. Promises of guaranteed high returns or recruitment commissions are warning signs; when unsure, decline or ask a licensed institution. This is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 熟人介绍项目、加盟或理财，越是碍于人情越要先核实资质、合同和资金去向，看清风险、收益来源和退出机制；承诺保本高息、拉人头返佣多为危险信号，拿不准就拒绝或咨询持牌机构，本文不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 和父母关系紧张怎么看？看懂父母宫，也找沟通边界
enTitle: How to Read a Tense Relationship With Parents: The Parents Palace and Boundaries
enDesc: The Parents Palace shows your bond with elders, communication style and generational differences. When the relationship is tense, separate differences in values, a way of caring, and control. As an adult, communicate with clear and gentle boundaries, stick to the issue and reduce confrontation while understanding their limits; improvement is usually a long, two-way process.
cnDesc: 父母宫可看与长辈的缘分、沟通方式和代际差异，关系紧张时先分清是观念差异、关心方式还是控制欲；成年后用清晰而温和的边界沟通，就事论事、减少对抗，同时理解父母的局限，关系改善通常是长期、双向的过程。

cnTitle: 婚后和老人同住怎么定边界？先立小家规则，再谈孝顺
enTitle: Setting Boundaries When Living With Elders: Small-Family Rules and Filial Care
enDesc: When living with elders after marriage, conflicts often come from unclear boundaries. The couple should first agree on the small family s finances, chores, parenting and routine, then respectfully explain to elders which decisions belong to the small family and where their participation is welcome, showing filial care while keeping independence; when differences arise, each person communicates with their own parents.
cnDesc: 婚后与老人同住，矛盾多来自边界不清；夫妻先就小家的经济、家务、育儿和作息达成一致，再以尊重方式向长辈说明哪些是小家庭的决定、哪些欢迎老人参与，既尽孝又保留独立空间，遇到分歧由各自子女出面沟通。

cnTitle: 要不要二胎？看精力、经济、照护和大宝的真实想法
enTitle: How to Decide on a Second Child: Energy, Finances, Care and the First Child
enDesc: A second child depends on the couple s energy, finances and housing, dependable childcare support, and the impact on the first child and on careers; it should be a fully discussed, mutual choice. Do not decide under elder pressure or for a preferred gender; think through the parenting responsibility and real costs first.
cnDesc: 二胎决定要看夫妻精力、经济与住房、可依赖的照护支持、以及对大宝和职业的影响，是夫妻共同且充分沟通后的选择；不为长辈压力、不为"凑个好字"勉强，把养育责任和现实成本想清楚再决定。

cnTitle: 孩子叛逆、不爱学习怎么看？先看关系，再谈成绩
enTitle: How to Read a Rebellious or Unmotivated Child: Relationship First, Grades Second
enDesc: A child s rebellion or dislike of study often signals emotion, peer issues, family relationships or learning difficulties. Repair the parent-child bond and understand the real cause before grades; use steady presence, concrete small goals and encouragement instead of blame and comparison, and seek professional psychological or educational help if low mood or abnormalities persist.
cnDesc: 孩子叛逆、厌学，往往是情绪、同伴、家庭关系或学习困难的信号，先修复亲子关系、了解真实原因，再谈成绩；用稳定的陪伴、具体的小目标和鼓励代替指责和比较，若持续情绪低落或明显异常，及时寻求专业心理或教育帮助。

cnTitle: 长期失眠、焦虑怎么看？盘面作参考，身心症状要就医
enTitle: How to Read Long-Term Insomnia and Anxiety: Chart as Reference, Symptoms Need Care
enDesc: Insomnia and anxiety can relate to stress, routine and emotion, and the Karma Palace shows a mental-state tendency, but insomnia lasting over two weeks, marked anxiety or physical symptoms are health problems that deserve care, not just divination. Keep regular sleep, reduce stimulants, exercise moderately, and seek a proper hospital sleep or mental-health evaluation; a doctor s diagnosis prevails.
cnDesc: 失眠、焦虑可能与压力、作息和情绪有关，盘上福德宫可看精神状态倾向，但持续两周以上的失眠、明显焦虑或躯体不适，是需要重视的健康问题，不应只靠命理；应规律作息、减少刺激、适度运动，并及时到正规医院睡眠或心理科评估，以医生诊断为准。

cnTitle: 家人有慢性病怎么照护？重规范管理，也照护自己
enTitle: Caring for a Family Member With a Chronic Illness: Standard Care and Looking After Yourself
enDesc: When a family member has a chronic illness, care focuses on taking medicine as prescribed, regular rechecks, recording indicators and lifestyle, and helping them build stable management. Caregivers should also divide tasks reasonably and keep time to recover, avoiding long-term exhaustion. If the condition changes or worsens acutely, seek care promptly and do not stop or change medicine yourself; diagnosis and treatment rest on a proper hospital and doctor.
cnDesc: 家人患慢性病，照护重点是按医嘱规范用药、定期复查、记录指标和生活方式，帮家人建立稳定管理；同时照顾者也要合理分工、留喘息时间，避免长期透支。病情变化或急性加重应及时就医，不自行停药换药，具体诊疗以正规医院和医生为准。

cnTitle: 搬家、择居怎么看？结合田宅宫，更看现实条件
enTitle: How to Read Moving and Choosing a Home: The Property Palace and Real Conditions
enDesc: The Property Palace shows your home environment and settling tendency, but choosing a place depends more on budget, commute, amenities, housing condition and contract terms; for rentals, check the lease term, deposit and repair responsibilities. Verify the real conditions and contract before deciding; feng shui can be a psychological reference but should not replace these hard factors.
cnDesc: 田宅宫可看居住环境与安家倾向，但择居更要看预算、通勤、生活配套、房屋状况与合同条款，租房还要看清租期、押金和维修责任；把现实条件和合同核对清楚，再做决定，风水说法可作心理参考，不应替代这些硬指标。

cnTitle: 适不适合养宠物？先看时间、预算、居住条件和长期责任
enTitle: How to Decide Whether You Are Ready for a Pet: Time, Budget, Housing and Long-Term Responsibility
enDesc: A pet is a responsibility of more than ten years. First assess the daily time you can give, the long-term budget for food and medical care, whether housing allows it, care during travel, and whether the whole family agrees. Do not get a pet on impulse if conditions are not ready; you can first pet-sit for a short time to confirm you can take responsibility.
cnDesc: 养宠物是十几年的长期责任，先评估每天可陪伴的时间、长期的医疗和喂养预算、居住环境是否允许、以及出差时的照护安排，全家是否同意；条件不具备时不冲动饲养，也可先短期帮忙照看，确认自己能负责再决定。

cnTitle: 遇到合同纠纷怎么看？先看合同、留证据、按流程主张
enTitle: How to Handle a Contract Dispute: Contract, Evidence and Process
enDesc: For a contract dispute, return to the contract itself: confirm each party s rights and duties, the breach clauses and the dispute-resolution method, and keep the contract, payment records, messages and performance evidence. Prefer negotiation or mediation, and if that fails, use the agreed arbitration or litigation while watching the limitation period; for significant amounts, rely on a lawyer and the written contract.
cnDesc: 合同纠纷先回到合同本身，确认双方权利义务、违约条款和争议解决方式，保留合同、付款记录、聊天和履约证据；优先协商或调解，协商不成再按约定仲裁或诉讼，注意诉讼时效，重大金额以专业律师和书面合同为准。

cnTitle: 被拖欠工资怎么办？先留证据，再按劳动监察和仲裁走
enTitle: How to Handle Unpaid Wages: Evidence, Labor Inspection and Arbitration
enDesc: If wages are unpaid, first keep the labor contract, attendance, pay slips, bank statements and communication records, and make a written demand to the employer. If negotiation fails, file a complaint with the labor inspectorate or apply for labor arbitration within the time limit; the exact process and documents follow the local labor authority and a qualified lawyer.
cnDesc: 被拖欠工资，先保存劳动合同、考勤、工资条、银行流水和沟通记录，与用人单位书面催讨；协商不成可向劳动监察部门投诉或依法申请劳动仲裁，注意申请时效，仲裁流程和材料以当地劳动部门和专业律师指引为准。

cnTitle: 预付卡商家关门跑路怎么办？留证据、集体投诉、依法追
enTitle: What to Do When a Prepaid-Card Merchant Runs Away: Evidence, Group Complaints and Legal Action
enDesc: When a prepaid-card merchant such as a gym, beauty salon or tutoring center closes and disappears, keep the contract, payment proof, membership card and messages, and calculate the unused balance. Complain promptly through 12315 and the market regulator, connect with other consumers for group action, and sue or report to police if fraud or deliberate fundraising is involved, relying on a lawyer and written evidence.
cnDesc: 健身房、美容、教培等预付卡商家跑路，先保存合同、付款凭证、会员卡和沟通记录，统计未消费余额；尽快通过12315、市场监管部门投诉，联系其他消费者集体维权，必要时起诉或报警（涉嫌诈骗或恶意圈钱时），具体以专业律师和书面证据为准。

cnTitle: 租房押金不退怎么看？看合同、验房记录和交接证据
enTitle: How to Handle a Rental Deposit Dispute: Lease, Inspection and Handover Evidence
enDesc: For a deposit dispute, read the lease terms on refund conditions, deductions and inspection, and keep move-in and move-out photos, the handover checklist, payment records and messages. A normal move-out should be refunded per the contract; if the landlord withholds without reason, negotiate first, then use community mediation, the 12345 hotline or litigation, with amounts governed by the written contract.
cnDesc: 押金纠纷先看租赁合同对退还条件、扣费项目和验房的约定，保留入住和退房时的房屋照片、交接清单、缴费和沟通记录；正常退租应按约退还，房东无理克扣可先协商，再通过社区调解、12345或诉讼主张，金额以书面合同为准。

cnTitle: 考证、考公能不能过？看学习宫位，更看投入和方法
enTitle: How to Read Passing a Certification or Civil-Service Exam: Study Palaces, Effort and Method
enDesc: Exam luck can reference the Career and Karma palaces and study stars such as Wen Chang, but passing depends mainly on preparation time, method, competition for the post and performance on the day. Calculate the applicant-to-opening ratio, your own foundation and available time, make an executable plan and practice real papers; the chart shows a state, not a result.
cnDesc: 考试运可参考官禄、福德与文昌等学习星曜的倾向，但能否通过主要取决于备考时间、方法、岗位竞争和临场发挥；把目标岗位的报录比、自身基础和可投入时间算清楚，制定可执行计划并做真题，盘给的是状态，不是结果。

cnTitle: 升学、考研、留学怎么选？看目标、成本与自身条件
enTitle: How to Choose Between Further Study, Grad School and Study Abroad: Goals, Costs and Conditions
enDesc: When choosing among further study, graduate school and study abroad, first clarify whether your career goal actually needs the degree, then compare the time, financial cost, admission difficulty and return of each path, together with your study state, family support and risk tolerance. Use the study and travel tendencies in the chart as a reference, deciding through research and rational comparison rather than following the crowd.
cnDesc: 升学路径的选择，先想清楚职业目标是否需要这个学历，再比较各路径的时间、经济成本、录取难度和回报，结合自身学习状态、家庭支持和风险承受力；用盘上学习和迁移的倾向作参考，最终靠信息收集和理性比较，而不是随大流。

cnTitle: 交通事故理赔怎么看？先保安全、定责任、留证据
enTitle: How to Handle a Traffic Accident and Claim: Safety, Liability and Evidence
enDesc: After a traffic accident, first ensure personal safety and promptly call the police and seek medical care; do not settle privately and flee. Photograph the scene, and keep the liability determination, medical records, receipts and repair bills, then report and claim through the insurance process. For disputes over compensation, use mediation or litigation; injury and compensation standards follow the police determination, insurance terms and a qualified lawyer.
cnDesc: 发生交通事故先确保人身安全、及时报警和就医，不私了逃逸；拍照固定现场、保存责任认定书、病历、发票和维修单据，按保险流程报案理赔，对赔偿有争议可申请调解或诉讼，伤残和赔偿标准以交警认定、保险条款和专业律师为准。

cnTitle: 看病就医怎么选？看症状选科室，按病情选医院层级
enTitle: How to Choose a Hospital and Department: Symptoms to Department and Severity to Hospital Level
enDesc: To seek care, first choose the department by the main symptom and body part (when unsure, start with general practice or the guidance desk); common and chronic conditions can be followed at proper primary or specialty clinics, while emergencies and difficult cases should go promptly to a higher-level hospital with the right capability. Use licensed medical institutions, keep records and test results, do not trust folk remedies or delay emergencies, and let the doctor s diagnosis and treatment prevail.
cnDesc: 就医先按主要症状和部位选对科室（拿不准可先到全科或导诊台），常见病、慢病可在正规基层或专科随诊，急危重症、疑难病及时到有相应能力的上级医院；认准正规医疗机构，保留病历和检查结果，不迷信偏方、不延误急症，诊断治疗以医生为准。
